title: jailint.toml
description: Settings for jailint and the lints jailsp reports.

exclude.markdownDescription: Globs (relative to this file) of files and directories not to lint: `*`, `**`, `?`.

absurd_comparison.markdownDescription: a comparison an unsigned value always passes or fails (`u >= 0`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#absurd_comparison)

almost_swapped.markdownDescription: `a = b; b = a;`, a swap that sets both to `b` (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#almost_swapped)

bitwise_precedence.markdownDescription: a bitwise operator that binds differently than in C (`1 << n - 1`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#bitwise_precedence)

defer_in_loop.markdownDescription: a `defer` in a loop body that cleans up something from outside the loop (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#defer_in_loop)

duplicate_condition.markdownDescription: an `else if` or `case` that repeats an earlier one (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#duplicate_condition)

format_arg_count.markdownDescription: a format string that uses more or fewer arguments than the call passes (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#format_arg_count)

identical_branches.markdownDescription: an `if`/`else` or `ifx` whose branches are the same (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#identical_branches)

identical_operands.markdownDescription: an operator with the same expression on both sides (`a == a`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#identical_operands)

infinite_loop.markdownDescription: a `while` whose condition nothing in the loop changes (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#infinite_loop)

integer_division_in_float.markdownDescription: an integer division whose result is used as a float (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#integer_division_in_float)

lossy_xx.markdownDescription: `xx` that narrows a number to a smaller type (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#lossy_xx)

manual_index_counter.markdownDescription: a counter incremented in a `for` loop that always equals `it_index` (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#manual_index_counter)

min_max.markdownDescription: `min(0, max(100, x))`, a clamp that is always one bound (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#min_max)

needless_bool.markdownDescription: `ifx c then true else false` and `if c return true; else return false;` (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#needless_bool)

no_effect.markdownDescription: a statement that computes a value and drops it (`x == 5;`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#no_effect)

range_past_count.markdownDescription: `for i: 0..xs.count` indexing `xs[i]`, one past the end (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#range_past_count)

redundant_cast.markdownDescription: a cast to the type the value already has (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#redundant_cast)

remove_in_for.markdownDescription: removing from an array while a `for` walks it forward (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#remove_in_for)

reversed_range.markdownDescription: a range whose start is above its end, which never runs (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#reversed_range)

self_assignment.markdownDescription: a value assigned to itself (`x = x;`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#self_assignment)

shadowed_it.markdownDescription: a nested `for` hides an `it` the enclosing loop uses (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#shadowed_it)

unused_import.markdownDescription: an `#import` nothing in its scope uses (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unused_import)

unused_parameter.markdownDescription: a parameter the procedure never uses (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unused_parameter)

unused_result.markdownDescription: a call to a library procedure that only computes a value, as a statement (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unused_result)

unused_variable.markdownDescription: a local variable that is never used (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unused_variable)

wrapping_constant.markdownDescription: a constant that wraps to the type the other operand gives it (`(0xffff_ffff - 40) / h`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jai/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#wrapping_constant)
